skript.thema: Whirl: an open-source AI chat app you can run yourself

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Want your own AI chat app with MIT-licensed code? Whirl publishes its full code under the MIT license. You can read it, run it, or help improve it.
teile.szene: Medium shot of the black-haired presenter in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses at a night desk, laptop showing a chat window, painted urban open-world poster style, warm neon lighting, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Models
teile.text: Whirl puts every top model in one conversation. It routes them through OpenRouter, with adjustable thinking levels.
teile.szene: Close shot of a painted tablet screen where one chat thread branches into several glowing model paths, urban comic poster style, bold ink contours, dim room lit by cyan light, central framing.

teile.name: Artifacts
teile.text: Say you need a chart or a document. Whirl calls these living artifacts. They stay editable in a side panel, and you can share them by link.
teile.szene: Over-the-shoulder shot of a monitor with a chat on the left and an editable chart in a side panel, painted game-poster look, soft office light, action centered, empty top and bottom areas.

teile.name: Memory and search
teile.text: There's long-term memory too. It carries preferences and projects across chats. Live web search and page reading ground answers in today's web.
teile.szene: Wide painted city-rooftop scene at dusk, the presenter flipping through glowing project notes while a holographic web page floats nearby, bold ink contours, warm orange sky, centered action.

teile.name: Tools
teile.text: You can connect your own tools over MCP, with OAuth included. Installable skills teach Whirl new tricks.
teile.szene: Close shot of hands plugging glowing modular blocks into a painted control panel, urban open-world poster style, cyan and amber lighting, detail centered with calm space above and below.

teile.name: Privacy
teile.text: Here's the surprising part. Locked chats are encrypted on your device, with a password the server never sees. Only zero-retention models answer them.
teile.szene: Close shot of a painted padlock glowing over a laptop keyboard in a dark room, bold ink contours, cyan rim light, the presenter's silhouette softly blurred behind, central composition.

teile.name: Setup
teile.text: Running it yourself takes setup. You'll need Bun, a free Convex account, a Clerk application, and an OpenRouter API key. The self-hosting guide covers each step.
teile.szene: Medium shot of the presenter at a desk with a terminal on one monitor and a checklist on another, painted urban game-poster style, moody cyan lighting, action centered.

teile.name: Limit
teile.text: Here's the honest limit. Billing, web search and memory each need their own keys. Leave one out, and Whirl hides that feature.
teile.szene: Close shot of a painted wall of toggle switches, some glowing cyan and some dark, urban open-world poster style, shallow depth, centered subject, calm dark margins.

teile.name: Payoff
teile.text: So can you run your own multi-model chat app? According to its documentation, yes, with those accounts and keys. We haven't tested it. Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Medium shot of the presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses closing a laptop with a satisfied look on a neon-lit city balcony, painted game-poster style, calm sky above, central framing.

Compare tools within a documented common role; never label a generative language model as a non-generative decision model just to fill a ranking. A title or hook must not promise hallucination-free results without explicit source support and scope.

Use unique and specific hooks instead of overused generic tech creator tropes.
Avoid prolonged static shots of documentation or code scrolling; switch visuals dynamically to maintain pacing.
Use relevant, contextual visuals through the outro and CTA; verify that assets and screenshots match the technical reality of the software discussed.

The AI chat app that sweats the details. Every top model, real memory, living documents, and your own tools. - 492 stars, license: MIT, created 2026-10-02
PRIMARY MODEL/PROJECT DESCRIPTION (not independently tested):
Whirl 

 
  The AI chat app that sweats the details. Every top model, real memory, 
  living documents, and your own tools, in one fast and friendly place.
 

 
   whirl.chat  ·
   Self-hosting  ·
   Architecture  ·
   Contributing 
 

---

Whirl is a full-stack AI chat app built on Next.js and Convex. It's the code
behind [whirl.chat](https://whirl.chat), published in full under the MIT
license. Read it, run your own, or help make it better.

## Features

- **Every top model** in one conversation, routed through
  [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai), with adjustable thinking levels.
- **Living artifacts:** documents, charts, and full interactive pages that
  stay editable in a side panel and can be shared by link.
- **Integrations** with your own tools over MCP (OAuth included), plus
  installable skills that teach Whirl new tricks.
- **Long-term memory** that carries preferences and projects across chats.
- **Live web search** and page reading for answers grounded in today's web.
- **Locked chats**, encrypted on your device with a password the server never
  sees, answered only by zero-retention models.
- **Incognito mode**, message queueing, voice input, image generation, file
  attachments, folders, sharing, and a lot of care around motion and polish.
- **Light and dark mode**, accent colors, and an installable mobile web app.

## Tech stack

Everything beyond Convex, Clerk, and OpenRouter is **optional** and switches
on with its own keys: billing (Autumn), web search (Exa), memory
(Supermemory), analytics (PostHog, Axiom), tracing (Braintrust), email
(Resend), and the support agent (Median). Leave them out and Whirl hides the
features they power. See [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md).

## Quick start

You'll need [Bun](https://bun.sh), a free [Convex](https://convex.dev)
account, a [Clerk](https://clerk.com) application, and an
[OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai) API key.

Open [localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) and say hi. The
[self-hosting guide](docs/self-hosting.md) covers each step in detail,
including the Clerk JWT template Convex needs and how to deploy to
production.

## Repository layout

## Documentation

- [Self-hosting](docs/self-hosting.md): run Whirl locally and in production
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every environment variable and
  what it switches on
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): how a message travels from the
  composer to the model and back
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): conventions, checks, and pull requests

## Contributing

Bug reports, ideas, and pull requests are all welcome. Start with
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), and please follow the
[code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Found a security issue? See
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
